# Expert Guide to Quality Natural Stone Slabs, Decorative Tile, and Landscape Stone

### The Da Vinci Difference: Direct Relationships with Premium Quarries

At Da Vinci Marble, we go to extraordinary lengths to source the finest quality [**slabs**](https://davincimarble.com/slab#eyJzb3J0U3RhdGUiOiJBIC0gWiIsImZpbHRlcnNTdGF0ZSI6eyJJc0luU3RvY2siOmZhbHNlLCJJc0RlYWxlciI6ZmFsc2UsIlNlYXJjaCI6IiIsIkNvbG9yIjpbXSwiTWF0ZXJpYWwiOltdLCJGaW5pc2giOltdLCJEaW1lbnNpb25zIjpbXX19). We’ve built decades-long direct relationships with top Italians and regional manufacturers who operate some of the world’s most prestigious quarries. 

These established partnerships grant us privileged access to exceptional materials that truly represent the cream of the crop. What sets us apart is our commitment to **[hand-selecting](https://davincimarble.com/about)** every slab, stone, and tile personally—never relying on photographs alone—a practice that significantly elevates our offerings and transforms your design projects.

### Our Stone Selection Process: From Quarry to Showroom

Our meticulous selection process involves:

* Regular visits to premium Italian quarries by our stone masters
* Personal inspection of each stone for quality, veining, and color consistency
* Multi-stage inspection at the quarry, before shipment, and in our warehouse upon arrival
* Careful documentation of each stone’s origin and characteristics

### Client Testimonial

_“The quality and variety of materials they resource is inspiring and the personal support and attention to our projects is both professional and personable.”_

_— John Maxwell, President, Pacific Peninsula Custom Group_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Natural Stone Selection

**How does Da Vinci Marble ensure the highest quality natural stone?**

We employ a multi-stage inspection process: first at the quarry, then before shipment, and finally at Da Vinci before delivery to your job site. This comprehensive approach ensures every stone meets our exacting standards.

**What makes Italian stone suppliers superior?**

Italian suppliers often control the most premium quarries worldwide, have generations of expertise in stone cutting techniques, and maintain the highest standards for stone selection and finishing processes.

**How does hand-selecting stone benefit my design project?**

Hand-selection ensures that what you see is exactly what you get—no surprises in coloration, veining, or quality. This personalized approach results in more successful design outcomes and higher client satisfaction.

### Ready to Explore Premium Natural Stone Options?

Experience the Da Vinci Marble difference by exploring our extensive collection of hand-selected natural stone slabs, decorative tile, and landscape materials.

Contact us at [**650-595-2500**](tel:16505952500) or **[schedule a visit to our showroom](https://davincimarble.com/schedule-visit)** to begin your journey to finding the perfect stone for your project.

# Bay Area's Premier Stone Service for Stone Tile and Marble Slabs

### Service That Matches Our Materials: The Da Vinci Difference

At Da Vinci Marble, the only thing that rivals the quality of our materials is the quality of [**our service**](https://davincimarble.com/about/). We build lasting relationships—with our suppliers, our employees, and most importantly, our clients. This relationship-centered approach creates a service experience unmatched in the stone and tile industry.

We collaborate closely with you throughout your project journey, tailoring our offerings to your specific needs and timeline—whether that means meeting short lead times or partnering in comprehensive project development. Our dedicated team of designers and global experts puts your vision at the center of everything we do.

### How Our Service Philosophy Sets Us Apart

* **Personalized attention:** Dedicated team members assigned to your project
* **Technical expertise:** In-house specialists to answer your most challenging questions
* **Proactive communication:** Regular updates and transparent information
* **Problem resolution:** Rapid response to any concerns, with a “do whatever it takes” attitude
* **Long-term partnership:** Supporting you from initial concept through installation and beyond

### Client Testimonial

_“Da Vinci Marble is an invaluable resource for PPCG, our clients, and our design team. Having such a resource within our community has made the process of selecting tile, stone, and slabs such a positive experience.”_ 

_— John Maxwell, President, Pacific Peninsula Custom Group_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Our Service

**What makes Da Vinci Marble’s service different from other stone suppliers?**

We put relationships at the heart of everything we do. Our team works collaboratively with you, offering personalized attention, rapid problem resolution, and a commitment to ensuring smooth installations that keeps projects on time and on budget.

**How does Da Vinci Marble handle timeline challenges?**

We understand the importance of meeting deadlines. Our local warehouses allow us to store materials until you’re ready to receive them on site, and our deep supplier relationships enable us to expedite orders when necessary.

**Can Da Vinci Marble help with complex or unusual design requirements?**

Absolutely. Our team excels at finding creative solutions for unique design challenges, whether that involves sourcing rare materials, creating custom cut-to-size elements, or developing prototypes to test finishes before final ordering.

### Experience Premier Stone Service in the Bay Area

Discover why designers, architects, and homeowners throughout the Bay Area trust Da Vinci Marble for exceptional service and stunning materials. Contact us at [**650-595-2500**](tel:16505952500) or **[schedule a visit to our showroom ](https://davincimarble.com/schedule-visit)**to experience our service difference firsthand.

# San Carlos' Premier Selection of Natural Stone Slabs and Decorative Tile

# The Art of Selecting the Perfect Stone and Marble Surface

### Mastering Stone Selection for Your Design Vision

Choosing the right **[stone](https://davincimarble.com/?s=stone)** surface for your project can be a daunting task, but with Da Vinci Marble’s expert guidance, you can confidently find the perfect **[stone](https://davincimarble.com/?s=stone)**, [**tile**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/), and [**marble**](https://davincimarble.com/slab/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=) to achieve your design vision.

At Da Vinci Marble, we offer a world of **[stone](https://davincimarble.com/?s=stone)** and tile for inside and out, ensuring that every piece is hand-picked for quality and aesthetic excellence. Our design consultants work closely with you to understand your project requirements and help you navigate our extensive selection.

### Key Considerations When Selecting Natural Stone

* Project location and usage: Different stones perform better in different environments
* Aesthetic preferences: Color, veining, pattern consistency, and visual impact
* Maintenance requirements: Some stones require more care than others
* Budget constraints: Finding the perfect balance of beauty and value
* Design coherence: Ensuring stone selections complement other design elements

### Client Testimonial

_“Da Vinci Marble was incredible from the moment we walked in the door. We drove over from Walnut Creek…The selection was incredible and the quality top-notch. They took the time to understand our needs and advise us on the various products available. We found the perfect counter tops that afternoon.”_ 

_— Todd S., Walnut Creek, CA_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Stone Selection

**How do I choose between marble, quartzite, and limestone for my project?**

Each stone type has distinct characteristics. Marble offers classic beauty with its distinct veining but requires more maintenance. Quartzite provides similar aesthetics with greater durability. Limestone delivers a more uniform, subtle appearance perfect for creating calm, elegant spaces. Our experts can help you weigh these factors based on your specific needs.

**What should I look for when examining stone slabs in person?**

Color consistency, veining patterns, visible fissures, and overall surface quality. View the stone under different lighting conditions, as natural light can reveal characteristics not visible under showroom lighting. Our experts can help you examine stones properly in our showroom.

**How much extra material should I order for my project?**

We typically recommend ordering 15-20% extra material to account for cuts, breaks, and future repairs. For more complex installations or stones with significant veining that requires matching, we might suggest ordering more. Our team of experts can provide specific recommendations based on your project details.

### Begin Your Stone Selection Journey

Ready to find the perfect [**marble**](https://davincimarble.com/slab/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=) or [**stone**](https://davincimarble.com/?s=stone) for your project? ### Elevating Your Kitchen with Premium Natural Stone

The kitchen is the heart of the home, and nothing transforms this essential space like Italian [**marble**](https://davincimarble.com/slab) and [**decorative tile**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/decorative/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=) from Da Vinci Marble. Our [**natural stone slabs**](https://davincimarble.com/slab) are [**hand-selected**](https://davincimarble.com/about/) from leading quarries in Italy and around the world.

We help clients find the perfect stone and tile for their kitchen renovations, offering expert guidance on everything from [**Calacatta marble**](https://davincimarble.com/?s=calacatta) and **[limestone tile](https://davincimarble.com/?current%5Ftab=slabs&s=limestone)** to **[granite slabs, ](https://davincimarble.com/?current%5Ftab=slabs&s=granite)**[**quartzite stone slabs**](https://davincimarble.com/?current%5Ftab=slabs&s=quartzite), and **[ceramic tiles](https://davincimarble.com/tile/decorative/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=)**.

### Popular Stone and Tile Options for Modern Kitchens

* **Countertops**: Quartzite for durability, marble for classic beauty, granite for low maintenance
* **Backsplashes**: Decorative tile, mosaic patterns, matching slab material
* **Islands**: Statement slabs with dramatic veining
* **Flooring**: Limestone or porcelain for durability and style

### Client Testimonial

_“Da Vinci Marble has been my go-to place for all kitchen and bathroom projects in the past ten years. They offer exceptional product quality, and their costumer care is exemplary.”_ 

_— SENGA Interior Design_

### Frequently Asked Questions About About Kitchen Stone and Tile

**What natural stone is best for kitchen countertops?**

While marble offers unparalleled beauty, quartzite provides similar visual appeal with greater durability and stain resistance. Granite remains popular for its durability and low maintenance. Our design consultants can help you weigh the aesthetic and practical considerations to find your perfect match.

**How do I coordinate stone countertops with tile backsplashes?**

The key is finding complementary elements rather than exact matches. Consider selecting a backsplash tile that picks up a secondary color in your slab or choosing contrasting textures that share a color palette. Our showroom allows you to view options side-by-side to find the perfect combination.

**What’s trending in kitchen stone and tile for 2025?**

We’re seeing continued interest in dramatic, book-matched marble for statement islands, contrasted with more subtle perimeter countertops. Textured finishes on both stone and tile are gaining popularity. Natural, earthy tones remain strong, with warm whites and soft greens leading color trends.

Natural stone can dramatically enhance both the beauty and functionality of your [**outdoor**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/outdoor/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=) spaces. At Da Vinci Marble, we offer an extensive selection of premium [**outdoor tile**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/outdoor/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=), [**limestone**](https://davincimarble.com/?s=limestone), [**travertine**](https://davincimarble.com/?current%5Ftab=slabs&s=travertine), [**porcelain**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/decorative/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=), and [**cladding**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/outdoor/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=) specifically designed for outdoor applications.

Our natural stone products deliver unmatched durability and timeless beauty for everything from [**patios to pool decks**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/outdoor/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=), garden pathways to exterior wall cladding.

### Key Benefits of Natural Stone for Outdoor Applications

* **Exceptional durability:** Withstands harsh weather conditions and heavy use
* **Timeless aesthetic:** Creates an elegant, permanent appearance that ages gracefully
* **Temperature regulation:** Natural stone remains cooler underfoot in hot weather
* **Low maintenance:** Requires minimal upkeep while maintaining its beauty
* **Environmental sustainability:** One of the most eco-friendly building materials available
* **Design versatility:** Available in countless colors, textures, and finishes

### Client Testimonial

_“We loved having the chance to personally select the slabs of granite for our outdoor kitchen. Everyone was helpful and attentive.”_ 

_— Doug B., Sunnyvale, CA_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Outdoor Stone

**What stone options work best for pool surrounds?**

For pool surrounds, we recommend limestone, travertine, or textured porcelain with slip-resistant finishes. These materials remain cooler underfoot in hot weather, provide excellent traction when wet, and offer natural beauty that complements water features. Our Signature Selection includes several options specifically curated for pool areas.

**How do outdoor stone materials handle freeze-thaw cycles?**

We carefully select outdoor stone products with the appropriate density and absorption rates to withstand freeze-thaw cycles. Our limestone and granite options are particularly resilient in variable climates. Additionally, proper installation with appropriate drainage is crucial, and our team can recommend experienced installers who understand these requirements.

**What maintenance do outdoor stone surfaces require?**

Most natural stone outdoor installations require minimal maintenance—typically just regular cleaning with mild soap and water. Depending on the stone type and application, sealing every 1-3 years may be recommended. During your consultation, we’ll provide specific care instructions for your selected materials.

Yes, we excel at coordinating custom carved elements with other stone surfaces in your home. # The Timeless Elegance of Travertine Stone

### The Enduring Allure of Travertine

Travertine stone offers a timeless elegance that enhances any interior or exterior space. This unique natural stone, formed over thousands of years in mineral springs and hot springs, brings warmth, texture, and sophistication to both traditional and contemporary designs.

At Da Vinci Marble, our [**Travertine**](https://davincimarble.com/?s=Travertine) selection is carefully curated from the finest quarries in Italy. We source only the highest quality materials, ensuring exceptional consistency and character in every piece.

### Versatile Applications for Travertine

* **Flooring:** Provides durable, comfortable surfaces with natural warmth
* **Wall cladding:** Creates textural interest and elegant neutral backdrops
* **Bathrooms:** Delivers spa-like ambiance in shower surrounds and vanities
* **Outdoor spaces:** Offers natural slip resistance and temperature moderation for patios and pool decks
* **Architectural elements:** Perfect for columns, fireplace surrounds, and accent walls

### Client Testimonial

_“The quality and variety of materials they resource is inspiring and the personal support and attention to our projects is both professional and personable.”_ 

_— John Maxwell, President, Pacific Peninsula Custom Group_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Travertine

**How does travertine compare to marble and limestone?**

Travertine belongs to the same stone family as marble and limestone but has distinct characteristics. It’s typically more porous than marble, with natural voids that can be filled or left unfilled for different aesthetics. Compared to limestone, travertine often has more varied texture and patterning. All three stones offer natural beauty, but travertine’s warm tones and unique texture make it particularly inviting for creating comfortable, welcoming spaces.

**Is travertine suitable for kitchen countertops?**

While travertine can be used for kitchen countertops, it requires proper sealing and maintenance due to its porosity and sensitivity to acidic substances. For busy kitchens, we often recommend using travertine as a backsplash or island accent paired with more durable countertop materials. For clients committed to travertine countertops, we recommend honed and filled options with quality sealing products and appropriate care protocols.

**What finish options are available for travertine?**

Travertine is available in several finishes, each offering a different aesthetic and functional quality:

* **Polished**: Smooth and somewhat reflective, highlighting the stone’s colors
* **Honed**: Smooth but matte, for a more subtle appearance
* **Brushed**: Lightly textured for added dimension and slip resistance
* **Tumbled**: Soft, rounded edges with an antiqued appearance
* **Unfilled**: Natural voids left open for a rustic, authentic look

### Discover Premium Travertine Options

Find the perfect [**travertine**](https://davincimarble.com/?s=Travertine) finish and format for your project at Da Vinci Marble. Contact us at [**650-595-2500**](tel:16505952500) or **[schedule a visit to our showroom](https://davincimarble.com/schedule-visit)** to explore our collection.

# Caring for Natural Stone and Calacatta Marble Surfaces

### Preserving the Beauty of Your Natural Stone Investment

Maintaining the beauty of your stone and marble surfaces is straightforward with the right care routine. Our [**experts**](https://davincimarble.com/about/) at Da Vinci Marble provide comprehensive guidance on best practices for cleaning and maintaining various natural stone surfaces to ensure their longevity and continued beauty.

With proper care, your [**Calacatta**](https://davincimarble.com/?s=Calacatta) marble countertops, [**decorative tile**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/decorative/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=), and other natural stone surfaces can maintain their stunning appearance for generations.

### Essential Care Tips for Natural Stone Surfaces

Regular Maintenance

* Clean spills promptly, especially acidic substances like lemon juice, wine, or tomato sauce
* Use pH-neutral cleaners specifically formulated for natural stone
* Wipe surfaces with a soft, damp cloth followed by a dry cloth to prevent water spots
* Use coasters under beverages and trivets under hot items

Periodic Maintenance

* Apply high-quality stone sealer as recommended (typically every 6-12 months for high-use surfaces)
* Have professionals address any etching, staining, or damage promptly
* Periodically inspect for signs of wear or damage to the sealant

### Client Testimonial

_“Da Vinci Marble have an amazing selection of beautiful tile and stone; they have superb customer service that made us completely confident in the material we selected. They have an expert Keith who really understands their materials and was so patient in helping me understand use of natural stone, the process for sealing, and maintenance recommendations.”_ 

_— Nell T., San Carlos, CA_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Stone Care

**How often should I seal my marble countertops?**

For kitchen countertops, we typically recommend sealing every 6-12 months depending on use. Less frequently used surfaces like bathroom vanities may need sealing only once per year. A simple water test can help determine if it’s time to reseal: if water beads up, your sealant is still effective; if it absorbs quickly, it’s time to reseal.

**What’s the best way to remove a stain from natural stone?**

Since each type of stone responds differently to a stain or treatment, the easiest thing to do is call us on 650-595-2500 and ask to speak with one of our experts on staff to help you, or send an email to: davincimarble.com/contact-us and ask us anything.

**Can etching on marble be repaired?**

Yes, etching (dull spots caused by acidic substances) can be repaired. Minor etching can often be polished out using marble polishing products specifically designed for this purpose. For more significant etching, professional refinishing may be necessary. Our stone care experts can recommend appropriate solutions based on the severity of the etching.

### Preserve Your Stone's Natural Beauty

Keep your marble and natural stone surfaces looking pristine with Da Vinci Marble’s care recommendations. For more specific advice about your particular stone and application, call us at [**650-595-2500**](tel:16505952500) or **[schedule a visit to our showroom](https://davincimarble.com/schedule-visit)**to talk with one of our stone experts.

# Modern Home Design with Porcelain, Ceramic, Terra Cotta and Moroccan Tile

### Versatile Tile Options for Contemporary Design

Porcelain, ceramic, terra cotta, and Moroccan tiles offer versatile and stylish options for any modern design project. Da Vinci Marble’s extensive collection of [**porcelain tiles**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/decorative/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=) and specialty tiles provides nearly limitless design possibilities for both [**residential**](https://davincimarble.com/portfolio/view/project/Residential/) and [**commercial**](https://davincimarble.com/portfolio/view/project/Commercial) spaces.

Our curated selection includes products from the world’s finest tile manufacturers, ensuring exceptional quality and design innovation. From handmade artisanal tiles to cutting-edge technical porcelains, we offer options to suit every aesthetic and functional requirement.

### Trending Tile Applications for 2025

* **Large-format porcelain slabs:** For seamless walls and shower surrounds
* **Textured ceramic tile:** Adding dimension to backsplashes and feature walls
* **Handcrafted Moroccan zellige:** For authentic character and artisanal charm
* **Terra cotta flooring**: Bringing warmth and timeless appeal to contemporary spaces
* **Geometric pattern tiles:** Creating visual interest in neutral spaces

### Client Testimonial

_“I like the fact that Da Vinci Marble carries quite a few different kinds of designs. Ranging from modern, traditional, country, and Spanish style tile.”_ 

_— Rachel F., Brooklyn, NY_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Designer Tile

**What’s the difference between porcelain and ceramic tile?**

Porcelain tile is fired at higher temperatures, making it denser, less porous, and typically more durable than ceramic tile. This makes porcelain an excellent choice for high-traffic areas and wet environments, whereas ceramic tile offers more design flexibility. Both can be excellent choices depending on your specific needs.

**Are Moroccan tiles practical for everyday use?**

Yes, traditional Moroccan zellige tiles have been used for centuries in demanding environments. Their handcrafted nature means some variation in size and texture, requiring skilled installation, but they offer exceptional durability once properly installed. For areas where maintenance is a concern, we also offer porcelain tiles with Moroccan-inspired designs that provide a similar aesthetic with easier care.

**What tile options work best for indoor-outdoor transitions?**

For spaces that flow between indoor and outdoor areas, we recommend frost-resistant porcelain tiles with anti-slip finishes. Many of our collections offer coordinating indoor tiles (polished or honed) and outdoor versions (textured) in the same colors and patterns, creating visual continuity while addressing the different performance requirements.

# Latest 2025 Trends in Decorative Tile

### Staying Ahead of the Design Curve

Interior designers today face increasing pressure to stay ahead of rapidly evolving trends in [**decorative tile**](https://davincimarble.com/tile/decorative/#eyJzZWFyY2giOiIiLCJmaWx0ZXJzIjp7ImNvbG9yIjpbXSwiYXBwbGljYXRpb24iOltdLCJtYXRlcmlhbCI6W10sImZpbmlzaCI6W10sImJyYW5kIjpbXSwic3RvbmVUeXBlIjpbXSwiZGVjb3JhdGl2ZV9tYXRlcmlhbHMiOltdfX0=). That’s why leading design professionals turn to Da Vinci Marble as their trusted resource for the latest innovations and timeless classics in tile design.

Our carefully curated selection brings the most current tile trends directly to your fingertips, whether you’re looking for artisanal Moroccan zellige, handcrafted terra cotta, technical porcelain, or innovative decorative concepts.

### Top Decorative Tile Trends for 2025

* **Textural surfaces:** Tiles with tactile, 3D elements creating visual movement
* **Terrazzo renaissance:** Modern interpretations of this classic material in bold new colorways
* **Artistic expression:** Hand-painted and artisanal tiles as focal points
* **Natural material:** Authentic stone and clay tiles with organic variations
* **Unexpected formats:** Unconventional shapes and installation patterns

### Client Testimonial

_“I HIGHLY recommend Da Vinci if you are looking for high quality, on trend product and exceptional service and care.”_ 

_— Todd S., Walnut Creek, CA_

### Frequently Asked Questions About Tile Trends

**How can I incorporate trending tile designs without creating a space that will look dated?**

We recommend balancing trend-forward elements with timeless foundations. Consider using statement tiles in spaces that can be more easily updated, such as powder room walls or kitchen backsplashes, while keeping larger applications like floors in more classic designs. Alternatively, choose trending colors or patterns in traditional formats, or vice versa. Our design consultants can help you find the perfect balance for your specific project.

**What tile trends offer the best combination of style and practicality?**

Large-format porcelain tiles continue to excel in balancing contemporary aesthetics with practical benefits. With fewer grout lines, these tiles create cleaner visual planes while being easier to maintain. Additionally, textured tiles that provide slip resistance without sacrificing style are increasingly popular for bathrooms and transitional indoor-outdoor spaces.

# The California Consumer Privacy Act

If you live in California and have an established business relationship with us, you can request a list of the personal information we have shared with third parties for their direct marketing purposes. We will also give you a list of the third parties that have received your information. You can make a request one time each year, by emailing or writing to us at the address below. Please mention in your letter that you are making a “California Shine the Light” inquiry. We will respond within 30 days.

The California Consumer Privacy Act provides that California residents may (subject to certain limitations):

* Request the personal information we collect about them
* Ask that we delete the personal information we collect about them
* Opt out of having their personal information sold (while we do not share personal information with third parties in exchange for money, we may share information with our business partners from time-to-time which is broadly defined as a “sale” under the CCPA). Please note that there may also be instances when we share information for Business Purposes for providing customer service, servicing warranty repairs or claims, or some additional exempted reason

[To exercise your rights, please click here.](https://davincimarble.com/contact-us/)

We value and respect the privacy of our customers. In the course of operating our business and interacting with you, we collect, use, and share personal information. We do so to process and fulfill your orders, to improve our product offerings, to provide valuable services, to protect the rights and information of our customers and our company.

## Exercise Your Privacy Rights

Complete the form below to submit your request. When we receive your information, we’ll use it to verify your identity and review your request.

You can:

* Request the personal information we collect about you.
* Ask that we delete the personal information we collect about you.
* Opt out of having your personal information sold (while we do not share your personal information with third parties in exchange for money, we disclose certain information in exchange for insights and other valuable services, and California law treats such sharing as a “sale” even if no money is exchanged.

### IMPORTANT NOTE REGARDING REQUESTS TO OPT OUT OF SALES

If you submit a request to opt out of having your personal information sold, we will the use the information you provide to verify your identity. After verifying your identity, we will associate the information you provided with information we hold to prevent further sales of that information. However, if you use our websites, mobile applications, connected device applications, or digital services, we may not be able to associate the information you provided in your request with the information collected from your usage of our websites, mobile applications, connected device applications, or digital services.

### Making a Request

A working email address is required to complete your request online. Call (714) 465-5220 to speak to a representative if you don’t want to provide an email address.

For each request you submit, we’ll send a verification email to the email address you provided. This may take up to 72 hours. Check your spam folder if you don’t see it. You’ll have 3 days to verify your email before your request expires. If you don’t, you’ll have to submit another request.

If you are making a request on behalf of another person, please send your request to info@davincimarble.com and include the following information about you and the person on whose behalf you are making the request: full name, mailing address, home address, email address, and phone number. You should also provide proof of your authorization to act on the other person’s behalf. We will contact you for additional information once your request has been received.

After we process your request to delete your personal information or to opt out of the sale of your personal information, you may still see advertising regarding our products and services. We may deliver advertising to a general audience or place advertising on websites, mobile applications, and connected device applications that relates to our products and services. For example, if you visit a do-it-yourself website, you may see advertising on that website that promotes our products and services related to the do-it-yourself content.

### HOW DO WE COLLECT INFORMATION?

We collect information directly from you.

For example, we collect information when you:

* Visit our Design Studios or other facilities
* Register for an account or complete a survey
* Make an online or in-store purchase
* Use an online forum, provide us with comments or reviews, or contact our call centers
* Upload or share a photo, submit a request, submit information, or post other digital content through one of our websites, applications or via social media interactions on third party websites like Google, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest or Twitter
* Request we send you an electronic copy of your in-store receipt
* Apply or inquire about employment
* Submit information via our websites, mobile websites, or applications

We collect information from you passively.  
We use tools like browser cookies, flash cookies, pixel tags, and web beacons to collect information when you use our websites and applications or interact with our emails. And we use cameras and other technologies in our stores, in parking lots and at other facilities to learn about customer traffic and for fraud prevention, security, and asset protection.

We collect information from Affiliates of Select Interior Concepts.  
We may receive information about you from companies that are controlled by or under common control with Select Interior Concepts (our “Affiliates”).

We collect information from third parties.  
In the course of serving you and operating our business, we collect information from a variety of third parties. For example, we collect information from:

* Shipping companies
* Installers
* Your friends and contacts
* Marketing companies that help us learn about consumer interests and trends
* Companies that supplement our customer records with additional information
* Online advertising and analytics providers
* Social media platforms
* Suppliers of property information
* Companies that help us process payments
* Service providers that operate on our behalf and collect information
* Financial institutions and other companies that help provide or support financial products and offers
* Security and fraud prevention providers
* Manufacturers and other businesses with which we conduct joint offers or programs

### WHAT DO WE COLLECT?

CATEGORY OF PERSONAL INFORMATION IDENTIFIERS, such as name, email address, phone number, username, physical address, device identifier, IP address, and social media handle.

WHERE DO WE COLLECT IT FROM?  
Directly from you or the devices you use to access digital services, such as websites, mobile applications, and applications for connected devices.

Other customers that may provide us with your information to recommend a product or service, ship products to you, or list you as a recipient of products or services.

Companies that provide services on our behalf (e.g., installers).

Security and fraud prevention services that help us confirm that transactions are valid and otherwise help us protect our assets and you.

Marketing companies that help us learn about our customers and the devices they use to access digital content.

Companies that supplement our customer records with additional information.

Shipping providers that update address information.

Social media platforms.

### WHY DO WE COLLECT IT?

Fulfilling orders and processing returns.

Customer care.

Administering contests and promotions.

Registering you for a website or program.

Communicating with you.

Improving our products and services, including improving store layouts and digital content.

Learning about customer trends and interests.

Personalizing digital content.

Delivering marketing communications and advertising.

Identifying the devices you use to access digital content.

Fraud prevention, security, and asset protection.

### WHO DO WE SHARE IT WITH?

Service providers that process information on our behalf, such as shipping vendors, providers of digital analytics services, and fraud prevention.

Manufacturers of products and providers of extended warranty services.

Any successor to all or part of our business.

Law enforcement, public and government authorities, and other entities as we deem reasonably necessary to comply with law, support investigations, and protect the rights and property of you, us, and others.

Our affiliates and subsidiaries.

### HOW DO WE USE INFORMATION?

Here are some examples of how we use the information we collect:

To respond to you and provide you with goods and services you request.

* Fulfilling orders, ensuring proper delivery, or providing services (such as delivering an electronic copy of your receipt)
* Responding to a product or service review

To improve our business, products, and services.

* Improving our websites, mobile applications, and applications for other connected devices
* Identifying ways to make our products and services better
* Improving store layouts
* Developing new ways to purchase and browse our products and services
* Personalizing the content on our digital services (e.g., websites, mobile applications, and connected device applications) so you have a consistent experience

To identify and assess website and device application trends and customer interests.

* Recommending products and services that may interest you
* Identifying the devices you use to interact with us so that we can provide you with a consistent experience
* Identifying your interests based on your interactions with us and information we have received from third parties or publicly available sources
* Updating our product inventories to meet projected demand

For security and asset protection purposes.

* In-store, parking lot, and facility cameras track store traffic and stock
* Mitigating credit losses
* Detecting and preventing fraud and malicious activities on our digital offerings and in your accounts

For our marketing.

* Sending you communications about special promotions or offers via regular mail, email, phone, or other electronic channels, including ads on social media platforms
* Sending you newsletters and other information you have requested
* Informing you of new in-store or digital products and service offerings
* Passing along information about offers from our Affiliates and other companies we think you might find interesting

To communicate with you about your account or our relationship.

* Notifying you about changes to this Privacy and Security Statement, the Terms of Use of our websites or device applications, or changes to any of our programs in which you might be enrolled
* Updating you regarding shipping, product availability, product recalls, or warranty information
* Sending you other transactional or relationship communications

For employment purposes.

* Processing and responding to your application for or inquiry regarding employment with us.

For social media engagement.

* When you engage with our content on or through social networking websites, plug-ins and applications, you may allow us to have access to certain social media account information (e.g., name, username, email address, gender) as determined by the settings of the social media platforms to deliver the content or as part of the operation of the website, plug-in or application
* Such social media platforms may collect information about your use of our services and may notify other users of the platform about your activities on our websites and device applications
* These social media platforms may also use cookies or other technologies to provide services or track your online activities over time and across multiple websites and device applications. Your interactions with social media features are governed by the respective privacy policies of the social media platforms

For other uses we may disclose to you.

* We may also use information for purposes disclosed to you at the point of collection, as authorized by you, or as otherwise permitted or required by law

### TRACKING TOOLS WE USE

We collect personal and other information using digital tracking tools, such as cookies and web beacons, when you use our websites or mobile applications, interact with our emails or applications provided on connected devices, or otherwise engage with our digital offerings. We also partner with third parties that collect information this way. These third parties may place similar tracking tools on our websites, applications, and advertising to facilitate tracking, advertising, and measurement services

The tools may collect information about your activities over time and on various digital services offered by us or others.

The tools that we, our vendors, and third parties use include:

* Browser and flash cookies. Cookies are small text files that websites send to your computer or other connected device to identify your browser or to store information or settings. Your browser may provide the ability to be notified when you receive certain types of cookies and how to restrict or disable certain cookies. Flash cookies generally can be disabled only by accessing Adobe Flash settings (information available here)
* Server logs, which record information about the device, browser, operating system, network, and other resources you use to access our digital services
* Web beacons and pixels. These are small electronic images deployed on websites and emails that collect information about how users interact with content
* Application software. Software in our mobile and other connected-device applications collects information about how you interact with the digital services

We, our service providers, and third parties use the information collected via these tools to:

* Identify new visitors and users
* Recognize returning customers
* Learn how you came to access our digital services
* Keep you logged into our digital services
* Personalize your experience on our website, device applications, and third-party social networking websites, plug-ins and applications
* Identify your location as determined by the IP address of your devices
* Optimize and tailor our websites and device applications
* Make product recommendations and provide you with advertising content in which we think you will be interested. As part of this customization, we may observe your behaviors on our device applications, our websites, or on other websites and applications. We may also get information about your browsing history and online activities from our trusted business partners and vendors
* Better understand our audience, our customers, our website visitors and device application users, and their respective interests, including by learning about your online activities across devices

## Custom Carved Stone Cabinetry

 Handcrafted in Italy. Designed for You.

## Transform Your Space with Artisan Craftsmanship

Experience the pinnacle of luxury with our custom carved stone vanities, meticulously handcrafted in Italy by master artisans. Each piece creates a truly unique centerpiece for your space.

**Calacatta Viola Custom Vanity**

Our showcase piece demonstrates the extraordinary possibilities of custom stone work:

![arrow](https://davincimarble.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/arrow.svg "arrow")

### Carved Stone Integration

* Hand-carved stone sink seamlessly integrated into the design
* Recessed soap dishes carved directly into the stone surface
* Integrated drain piece with matching stone cap for flawless continuity

![arrow](https://davincimarble.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/arrow.svg "arrow")

### Functional Luxury

* Stone-clad cabinetry with operable drawers and doors
* Wooden frame construction to reduce weight while maintaining strength
* Custom dimensions available to fit your exact specifications

![arrow](https://davincimarble.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/arrow.svg "arrow")

### Premium Materials

* Calacatta Viola marble exterior cladding
* Available in a variety of natural stone materials (with some limitations)
* Each slab hand-selected for optimal beauty and performance

**Paonazzo Marble Custom Cabinet**

Our showcase piece demonstrates the extraordinary possibilities of custom stone work:

![arrow](https://davincimarble.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/arrow.svg "arrow")

### Carved Stone Integration

* Hand-carved stone seamlessly integrated into the design
* Vein continuation on all drawers and fluted sides

![arrow](https://davincimarble.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/arrow.svg "arrow")

### Functional Luxury

* Stone-clad cabinetry with operable drawers and doors
* Wooden frame construction to reduce weight while maintaining strength
* Custom dimensions available to fit your exact specifications

![arrow](https://davincimarble.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/arrow.svg "arrow")

### Premium Materials

* Paonazzo marble exterior cladding
* Available in a variety of natural stone materials (with some limitations)
* Each slab hand-selected for optimal beauty and performance

## Your Vision, Our Expertise

When standard sizes don’t meet your needs, our custom cut-to-size program ensures your stone selections are made to your exact specifications. From material selection to working with your installers, we are your resource at every stage to bring your design to life—on time and on budget.
